03-ai-chat.title: 03 AI Chat
03-ai-chat.how: AI states are driven by a scripted FAKE ACP agent (MAUDE_ACP_ADAPTER_ENTRY, never a provider) that calls the design plugin's own hook code, so the studio's run registry, leases, scope checks and result card are the real ones; the prompt text picks the behaviour (hang / permission / question / fail / tell / default edit). Project: generated "Alligators brand" with a 5-artboard Combine-kampan. The not-ready frames use the default signed-out claude stub.

04-modes.title: 04 Modes
04-modes.how: Project: generated "Studio site" (Homepage with a data-cd-link to Pricing, Pricing, Combine-kampan, six photos in Assets). Modes are driven through the Share-cluster testids and the in-frame toolbar (frameLocator); the md-edge-ai frame uses the fake agent from 03.

06-advanced.title: 06 Advanced
06-advanced.how: Project: the 03 "Alligators brand" fixture plus a deliberately broken canvas (Broken.tsx). Every frame opens one panel's Advanced fold through its testid or the visible 'Advanced' row, or the Diagnostics / Settings / palette routes.
